calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-21-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Everett A. Hewlett, Jr., Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Ruofang Chen was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor Wei Chen, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner and the minor were placed under oath and examined.
Wei Chen was placed under oath and served as Mandarin speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Xiang Kai Chen, the minor's father, was present, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Steven Chen.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
